summary: Senior Software Engineer and Chief Consulting Engineer with extensive expertise in full-stack development, Python, TypeScript, and AI-assisted tooling. Proven background in designing and scaling test automation, data processing pipelines, and cloud-integrated applications utilizing Google Cloud and Vertex AI.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Architected and developed full-stack web applications and AI-powered hiring manager tools using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
Integrated Google Cloud backend services including Vertex AI, Cloud Firestore, and Cloud Storage for advanced data processing and AI applications.
Engineered AI-powered photo transformation applications utilizing Google Gemini and Vertex AI deployed on Vercel.
Conducted self-directed graduate-level study on generative AI applied to software development, testing, and automated documentation.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Developed and verified instrument software using Python for medical point-of-care test instruments.
Created comprehensive documentation including User Manuals on Confluence and API Reference documentation via Sphinx extensions.
Performed cellular radio modem testing and supported over-the-air (OTA) verification with specialized RF test equipment.
Configured complete remote access test platforms for continuous integration and real target testing.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Developed highly object-oriented test frameworks in Python 2.7 for automotive Over-the-Air (OTA) firmware update testing.
Implemented modular, dynamically loaded test procedures with full resource context management and multi-level logging.
Created extensive YAML configuration files for test parameterization and streamlined test execution control.
Utilized Linux utilities and Python modules (Selenium, paramiko, subprocess, json) for robust system integration.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Developed hardware and software configurations for standalone production test stations running on RHEL 6.3.
Wrote all analog and digital software in Python 2.7 running on Debian Linux for a 5-microcomputer BeagleBone Black cooling unit test station.
Created telemetry event data log visualizations using numpy, pandas, and matplotlib across multiple measurement dimensions.
Constructed SQL databases for parsed, cleaned telemetry data and synchronized environmental data collection with system-level testing.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented timing calibration features for a 192-channel digital Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) instrument using C++ and Python.
Generated custom XML timing patterns using automated Python scripts to support complex testing configurations.
Co-designed parallel, binary search object-oriented software components.

education.details: Thesis focused on online diagnostic software for digital telephone switch systems.
